title: Ask HN: I have been unemployed for 2y. 15 years of experience, US. What to do?
why_read: A personal career-advice thread about long-term unemployment in tech, useful as a pulse check on the job market but not a technical piece.
analysis: This is an Ask HN thread from a senior engineer who has been jobless for two years, asking the community for advice given their 15 years of experience. It is not a technical artifact itself but a discussion that can surface real information about hiring difficulties, ageism, skill mismatches, or market conditions for experienced engineers. The high engagement suggests many readers relate to or have opinions on this, making it a useful barometer of industry sentiment. It is more career/culture content than engineering content, so interest for a technical digest is moderate.
